    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`Server-side keywords like `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`SYSDAY`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`SYSDATE`}</inlineCode>{`, and `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`&PERSONID&`}</inlineCode>{` work perfectly when querying the Maximo server through REST API. However, in mobile disconnected mode, these keywords cannot be processed because there’s no server connection. This guide shows how to replace these keywords with dynamic values that work in offline mode.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Filtering work orders by current date in mobile offline mode`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Using dynamic user information in mobile queries`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Creating date-based filters that work offline`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Implementing time-sensitive filters for mobile apps`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Prerequisites:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Understanding of `}<a parentName="li" {...{

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important Note:`}</strong></p>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote">{`Mobile QBE filters only work on data already downloaded to the device. They filter the local database, not the server.`}</p>
    </blockquote>
    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Identify the server keyword to replace`}</h3>
    <p>{`Common server keywords that need replacement:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`SYSDAY`}</inlineCode>{` - Current date (no time component)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`SYSDATE`}</inlineCode>{` - Current date and time`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`&PERSONID&`}</inlineCode>{` - Current user’s person ID`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`&USERID&`}</inlineCode>{` - Current user ID`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`&SITEID&`}</inlineCode>{` - Current site ID`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example server query:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- This works on server but NOT in mobile offline mode -->
<maximo-datasource id="todayWorkDS" 
                   where="schedstart <= SYSDAY"
                   mobile-qbe-filter="{{'schedstart': '<=SYSDAY'}}"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Replace with dynamic value using state`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Option A: Using Application State`}</strong></p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="todayWorkDS" 
                   object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL"
                   where="schedstart <= SYSDAY"
                   mobile-qbe-filter="{{'schedstart': '<='+app.state.currentDate}}">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="attr_001"/>
    <attribute name="schedstart" id="attr_002"/>
    <attribute name="description" id="attr_003"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Custom Application Logic
 */
const TAG = 'DynamicFilter';

class AppCustomizations {
    /**
     * Initialize application
     * @param {Application} app - The application instance
     */
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Set dynamic filter values when datasource initializes
     * @param {Datasource} datasource - The datasource being initialized
     * @param {Object} owner - The owner of the datasource
     * @param {Application} app - The application instance
     */
    onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
        if (datasource.name === 'todayWorkDS') {
            // Convert current date to ISO format for mobile QBE
            const today = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(new Date());
            
            // Store in application state for use in mobile-qbe-filter binding
            app.state.currentDate = today;
            
            this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Set current date for mobile filter: \${today}\`);
        }
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 3: Alternative - Update datasource query directly`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Option B: Direct Query Update`}</strong></p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'DynamicFilter';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Update datasource query with dynamic values
     * @param {Datasource} datasource - The datasource being initialized
     * @param {Object} owner - The owner of the datasource
     * @param {Application} app - The application instance
     */
    onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
        if (datasource.name === 'todayWorkDS') {
            // Get current date in ISO format
            const today = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(new Date());
            
            // Update the mobile QBE filter directly
            datasource.updateBaseQuery({
                "mobileQbeFilter": {
                    "schedstart": \`<=\${today}\`
                }
            });
            
            this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Updated mobile QBE filter with date: \${today}\`);
        }
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Complete Examples`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Example 1: Filter by Date Range`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'DateRangeFilter';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Set up date range filter for mobile
     * @param {Datasource} datasource - The datasource
     * @param {Object} owner - The owner
     * @param {Application} app - The application
     */
    onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
        if (datasource.name === 'weekWorkDS') {
            const today = new Date();
            const weekFromNow = new Date();
            weekFromNow.setDate(today.getDate() + 7);
            
            // Convert to ISO format
            const startDate = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(today);
            const endDate = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(weekFromNow);
            
            // Update filter for work orders in next 7 days
            datasource.updateBaseQuery({
                "mobileQbeFilter": {
                    "schedstart": \`>=\${startDate}\`,
                    "schedfinish": \`<=\${endDate}\`
                }
            });
            
            this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Filtering work orders from \${startDate} to \${endDate}\`);
        }
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 2: Filter by Current User`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'UserFilter';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Filter by current user's labor code
     * @param {Datasource} datasource - The datasource
     * @param {Object} owner - The owner
     * @param {Application} app - The application
     */
    onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
        if (datasource.name === 'myWorkDS') {
            // Get current user information
            const userInfo = app.client.userInfo;
            const laborCode = userInfo?.labor?.laborcode;
            
            if (laborCode) {
                // Filter work orders assigned to current user
                datasource.updateBaseQuery({
                    "mobileQbeFilter": {
                        "assignment[0].laborcode": laborCode
                    }
                });
                
                this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Filtering work orders for labor: \${laborCode}\`);
            } else {
                this.app.log.w(TAG, 'No labor code found for current user');
            }
        }
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 3: Multiple Dynamic Filters`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'MultiFilter';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Set up multiple dynamic filters
     * @param {Datasource} datasource - The datasource
     * @param {Object} owner - The owner
     * @param {Application} app - The application
     */
    onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
        if (datasource.name === 'priorityWorkDS') {
            const today = new Date();
            const todayISO = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(today);
            const userInfo = app.client.userInfo;
            const siteId = userInfo?.defaultSite;
            
            // Build complex filter
            const mobileFilter = {
                "schedstart": \`<=\${todayISO}\`,
                "status_maxvalue": "!=COMP,CAN,CLOSE",
                "wopriority": "<=2"
            };
            
            // Add site filter if available
            if (siteId) {
                mobileFilter.siteid = siteId;
            }
            
            datasource.updateBaseQuery({
                "mobileQbeFilter": mobileFilter
            });
            
            this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Applied multi-filter: \${JSON.stringify(mobileFilter)}\`);
        }
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 4: Refreshing Filter on Page Resume`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`const TAG = 'RefreshFilter';

class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    /**
     * Refresh date filter when page resumes
     * @param {Page} page - The page
     * @param {Application} app - The application
     */
    pageResumed(page, app) {
        if (page.name === 'workOrderList') {
            const datasource = page.datasources['todayWorkDS'];
            
            if (datasource) {
                // Update to current date (in case app was open overnight)
                const today = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(new Date());
                
                datasource.updateBaseQuery({
                    "mobileQbeFilter": {
                        "schedstart": \`<=\${today}\`
                    }
                });
                
                // Reload data with new filter
                datasource.load();
                
                this.app.log.d(TAG, \`Refreshed filter with current date: \${today}\`);
            }
        }
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>

    <h2>{`Date Formatting Reference`}</h2>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// Get current date/time
const now = new Date();

// Convert to ISO format for mobile QBE
const isoDate = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(now);
// Result: "2026-01-13T00:00:00+00:00"

// Get date only (no time)
const dateOnly = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(new Date(now.setHours(0,0,0,0)));

// Get date 7 days from now
const future = new Date();
future.setDate(future.getDate() + 7);
const futureISO = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(future);

// Get date 7 days ago
const past = new Date();
past.setDate(past.getDate() - 7);
const pastISO = app.dataFormatter.convertDatetoISO(past);
`}</code></pre>
